subject: GCP Marketplace payout: entity mapping & withholding clarification
messages:
From: Sabrina Cole <sabrina@cloudops.co>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: GCP marketplace payout shortfall — entity mapping discrepancy

Hi Jonas,

We're seeing a shortfall on the May GCP Marketplace payout for our account (CloudOps Solutions). GCP applied a 25% withholding on the gross settlement citing an "entity mismatch" between the invoice recipient and the registered marketplace entity. Our finance team cross-checked and the invoices Redwood provided list the UK entity (CloudOps UK Ltd) while GCP's payout went to CloudOps EU BV. We've attached a compact ledger export and the invoice PDF for reference.

Can you confirm which entity Redwood reported to GCP for May? This withholding will materially delay our vendor payments. If there's any paperwork we should send (W‑8/W‑9 equivalent or VAT registration proof), point us to the right contact.

Thanks — Sabrina

--
Sabrina Cole
Head of Finance, CloudOps Solutions
sabrina@cloudops.co
+44 20 7946 0123

Attachments: cloudops-ledger-may.csv (CSV, 12 rows) | gcp-invoice-202805.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: GCP marketplace payout shortfall — entity mapping discrepancy

Hi Sabrina — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Short answer: we reported the payout entity per the merchant profile CloudOps set up in our marketplace onboarding (CloudOps EU BV). That said, there are two things we should do immediately:

1) Confirm the exact merchant entity Redwood submitted to GCP for the May settlement window (we'll pull the submission records).
2) If GCP has the wrong intended recipient, we'll raise an immediate manual correction request with the marketplace billing team.

I've looped in Karthik from Marketplace Integrations to pull the submission logs and Marissa from Finance to help coordinate a manual payout if required.

Can you confirm whether CloudOps intended proceeds to go to CloudOps UK Ltd or to the EU entity? Also: do you have a PDF of the corporate registry or VAT cert that matches the UK entity if that's the correct destination?

Jonas

Subject: Re: GCP marketplace payout shortfall — entity mapping discrepancy

Hello Jonas / Marissa / Sabrina,

Thank you for contacting GCP Marketplace Billing. We reviewed the May settlement and confirmed that the disbursement record submitted by Redwood referenced merchant ID RWF-98765 and the legal entity name "CloudOps EU BV" (VAT: NL123456789B01). Our payout ledger shows a withholding applied per automated tax rules because the remittance country (Netherlands) and the invoice recipient country (United Kingdom) have a cross-border withholding flag in our system.

We can process a retrospective re‑remittance if a valid entity mapping change request is submitted with supporting documents:
- legal entity certificate for CloudOps UK Ltd
- UK VAT registration extract (if VAT is to be applied)
- signed remittance authorization confirming the target payout entity

Please note processing time for re‑remittance is typically 6-8 business days after approval and may require a manual settlement adjustment on our side. If Redwood would like, we can accept the submitted change request form directly from your team.

Regards,
Oliver Ramos
GCP Marketplace Billing Operations
marketplace-billing@google.com

Attachments: none

Quick internal plan and ask:

Summary: GCP withheld 25% due to cross-border remittance rules because the settlement record used CloudOps EU BV as the payee while invoices reference CloudOps UK Ltd. GCP can re‑remit to the UK entity with supporting docs; turnaround ~6–8 business days.

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: prepare a manual payout request form and collect the finance docs from CloudOps (Sabrina, please upload the UK company cert and VAT extract to the Drive link above). Once you have the files, I'll submit the entity mapping change to GCP. (owner: marissa_cole; due EOD 2028-05-24)
- Karthik: pull the original merchant submission packet for May (merchant ID RWF-98765) and extract the submission timestamps and confirmation ID for our ticket with GCP. We'll need those in the change request. (owner: karthik_iyer; due EOD 2028-05-23)
- Jonas: coordinate with GCP (Oliver) for expedited review once docs are uploaded. I'll also ask Finance to provision a one‑time expedited manual payout for CloudOps to cover critical vendor obligations if GCP delay exceeds 10 business days.

CloudOps: Sabrina — appreciate your quick upload and confirmation on which legal entity should ultimately receive proceeds. If you prefer Redwood to submit on your behalf, we can, but we need signed remittance authorization from CloudOps legal.

I'll update the thread as soon as Marissa has the docs and Karthik has the submission packet.

Thanks,
Jonas
